rules: Transform active sentence dynamics into formal passive setups, checking structural agent positioning.
Execute nominalisation tasks where an adjective or action verb must morph into its abstract noun format (e.g., 'He was angry' -> 'Due to his anger').
Test high-level logical subordinators ('Despite', 'In spite of', 'Much to his', 'No sooner had').
component_skills: Morphing phrase classes into abstract nouns
synthesis_nominalisation.solution_steps: 1. Isolate the target verb or description unit from the seed phrase. 2. Extract its matching abstract noun expression format. 3. Structure the resulting prepositional block, checking subject-verb alignment.

rules: Generate a premium, multi-layered text narrative/exposition (350-450 words) displaying standard PSLE tonal complexity.
Formulate a structured set of 4 questions covering specific analytical markers: literal recall, inferential character motivations, and true/false verification matrices requiring textual quotes.
Answers must rely purely on extraction or deduction from the text context, without using external knowledge.
comprehension_open_ended.solution_steps: 1. Locate the query anchor keywords within the text passage. 2. Assess the context surrounding the line to uncover implicit motives or values. 3. Draft a precise explanation statement that answers the question directly.
